title: 45 ta oltin medal: Osiyo para o'yinlarida tarixiy natija

scenes.text: Kimdir bahona qidiradi, kimdir yo'l qidiradi.
2026 yil oktyabrda Yaponiyada Osiyo para o'yinlari bo'lib o'tdi.
scenes.keywords: para athletes entering stadium crowd cheering

scenes.text: O'zbekiston para-sportchilari 45 ta oltin medal bilan o'z rekordini yangiladi.
scenes.keywords: para athlete crossing finish line arms raised

scenes.text: Jamoa umumiy hisobda uchinchi o'rinni egalladi.
To'siq bor joyda ham yo'l topish mumkin.
Sen qaysi birini tanlaysan: bahona qidirishnimi yoki yo'l qidirishnimi?
scenes.keywords: para swimmer diving pool slow motion

description: 2026 yil oktyabrda Aichi-Nagoyada o'tgan Osiyo para o'yinlarida O'zbekiston para-sportchilari 45 ta oltin (jami 145 ta) medal yutib, o'z rekordini yangiladi va umumjamoa hisobida uchinchi o'rinni egalladi.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-07 (fixed wording: 'record' = Uzbekistan's own best, not an all-Asia record). Kun.uz, 2026-10-26: https://kun.uz/en/news/2026/10/26/uzbekistan-wins-145-medals-to-finish-third-at-asian-para-games-in-japan ; Daryo: https://daryo.uz/en/2026/10/26/uzbekistan-wins-145-medals-and-finishes-third-at-5th-asian-para-games-in-japan/ ; gov.uz: https://gov.uz/en/yoshlar/news/view/237583 ; UzDaily: https://www.uzdaily.uz/en/uzbekistan-finishes-third-at-asian-para-games/ ; Zamin.uz: https://zamin.uz/en/sport/225389-45-gold-medals-and-third-place-in-asia-uzbekistan-sets-historic-record-in-para-sports.html . Games held 18-24 Oct 2026, Aichi-Nagoya. 45 gold, 49 silver, 51 bronze = 145; 3rd behind China and Japan.
